no_adcom_quote.quote: Although lenvatinib is a NME, an advisory committee meeting was deemed as not necessary for this application. The endpoint, PFS, was considered acceptable during the review of the sorafenib thyroid cancer application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for LENVIMA (lenvatinib) NDA206947. The FDA Office of Oncology Drug Products deemed an Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) meeting unnecessary because Study 303 showed a clinically meaningful, statistically robust PFS benefit with an acceptable safety profile and no controversial issues; the PFS endpoint had already been accepted during the prior sorafenib thyroid cancer review. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
